body:
Audit the Rust crate (`solace-cli/src`) and produce the refactor plan the later tasks follow.

### Where to look

- Module size and mixed responsibilities: `main.rs` (5302 lines), `board.rs` (4532), `lockdown.rs` (3196), `tasks.rs` (2810), `extract.rs` (2474), `view.rs`, `reach.rs`.
- Duplication between modules and repeated inline logic (path checks, project resolution, JSON plumbing).
- Dead code and unused helpers; test layout (`board_tests.rs`, `tests/*.py`) and what the Rust tests vs Python acceptance tests cover.
- How modules share state and which boundaries `extract`/`merge` can move cleanly.

### Deliverable

A plan note: which modules to split and into what, shared helpers to extract, dead code to remove, and the order of work — each step small enough for one task, ordered so tests keep passing. Flag anything that needs a decision from the human as questions.
title: Investigate root project refactor plan
